title: 7 channels. Every logger.
captions:
7 channels. Every logger. 📊

Unipro, AiM MyChron 5 or Alfano, Kart Connect pulls the lot onto one screen:

💨 Speed (GPS)
⚙️ RPM
↔️ Lateral G
↕️ Longitudinal G
⏱️ Δ Time
💧 Water temp
🔥 EGT

Different brands, same screen, lap against lap. Live on the web 1st December. 🏁

title: Feel the G
captions:
Feel the G. See the G. 🌀

Lateral G shows how hard you're loading the kart through every corner. Longitudinal G shows every braking zone and every exit.

Overlay two laps in the Kart Connect Data Logger and see exactly who's committing more in the fast stuff, and who's braking later. 🔥

🔗 kart-connect.com

#KartConnect #DataLogger #Karting #KartData #GForce

Cornering load. Braking force. Lap against lap. 🌀

G-force traces in the Kart Connect Data Logger.

🔗 kart-connect.com

#KartConnect #DataLogger #Karting

Think you're braking late? The G trace knows. 👀

Longitudinal G shows every braking point, lateral G shows how much grip you're actually using. Put your lap next to a quicker one and the difference jumps out. 🏁

title: Who's quicker here?
captions:
Who's quicker here? 🤔

Lap 8: 71 km/h. Lap 3: 68 km/h. Same corner, 3 km/h difference.

Tap any point on the Kart Connect track map and see both laps' speed and time at that exact spot. That's where the tenths are hiding. ⏱️
